verdict.rationale: ClickHouse exposes an HTTP interface: the changelog documents the X-ClickHouse-Format HTTP request header for selecting response format, and a probe found a published OpenAPI spec at clickhouse.com/openapi.json. The pack gives no in-depth API reference, so the breadth of API-driven control is unproven. Missing for 10: comprehensive public API reference documentation (endpoints, auth, operations), evidence the API covers management beyond queries, independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://clickhouse.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
The X-ClickHouse-Format HTTP request header now explicitly selects the format of the response: it is an alias for the output_format setting, so it overrides the FORMAT clause of the query
